# Vendored assets (assembly mode)

Pinned, self-hosted open-source assets INLINED into assembled pages so every
artifact is fully self-contained. Do not edit by hand — regenerate with
`scripts/build_vendor_assets.sh`.

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `app.css` | Tailwind CSS v4.3.2 + DaisyUI v5.6.6, compiled over `src/templates/web_design/v2/**` | MIT |
| `htmx.min.js` | htmx.org 2.0.10 | BSD-2-Clause |
| `alpine.min.js` | Alpine.js 3.15.12 | MIT |
